summary: Threaded standoff (brass, steel or nylon, hex or round), body from z = 0 up; a male thread goes below z = 0 or above the body depending on the type (M2x16_brass_pillar's is on top). The library draws M4x17_nylon_pillar 20 mm tall despite its name.

checks.source: library row (M3x20_hex_pillar in pillars.scad): generic M3 brass hex standoff, male/female, 5 AF (5.774 across corners on x) - Würth and Harwin M3 brass hex standoffs use 5.5 AF; z is the 20 body plus the library's 8 mm male thread
